source: Frozen response_model/examples.npz and verified score_structure_full_run01/beat_map.csv.gz; preserve the preceding 329 recording cohort and both search directions
alignment: Within one role/view/piece/grid/type, require the entire ordered primary-part coordinate_verified beat sequence to match: visit_index, measure_index, written start/stop quarters (1e-8 quantization). Check matching context values and validity. Do not equate segments only because both have 17 points; do not merge repeat occurrences or distinct grids.
inputs: Existing seven residual curves after search-view mean removal, 17 positions, observed/hidden mask; no piece ID, performer ID, score values, duration, kind ID or passage ID enters the primary search encoder
architecture: Performance Conv1d -> three width32 dilated blocks -> ordered flatten -> raw32 and unit32 embedding. Separate score context branch enters only conditional response/reconstruction decoder. Direct distances use unit32 with no train-axis rescaling.
targets: Train-search-view only: normalized tempo/dynamics differences, standardized tanh log1p difference-RMS amplitude, direction, observed peak, raw H lag correlations with validity. Continuous pair distances derive from full observed targets, never masked targets or opposite-view judge arrays.
pair_distance: Available block-weight-renormalized mean squared target difference (0..4); per-coordinate joint validity. Constant shape is unsupported, not forced to equal a changing curve; its amplitude remains observed. Pair only distinct recordings in the exact same aligned passage.
metric: SmoothL1(unit-embedding squared Euclidean distance, detached continuous target distance), averaged within passage then equally across sampled passages, both mild-mask versions. No binary other-performer negatives, no cross-passage negatives.
sampler: 8 passage draws with replacement balanced by family/work-grid/P-vs-H/H-metric/passage; each draw selects up to8 distinct recording owners without replacement. No validation/test sample can enter a train batch.
future_selection: Select checkpoint by group-balanced validation objective within own search view. Prior test results already informed this design: the 45-recording test is now a reused development benchmark, not a fresh confirmatory test. Reserve new families or perform nested family cross-validation for a final claim.
future_evaluation: First compare same-passage heldout-work pair distances and within-work recording ranking, including returned-work random-recording expectation; separately evaluate existing opposite-view 7 proxies and cross-work generalization. Source target-matched metric fit is not independent musical validation. Final relevance requires different metrics/listening evidence.
limits: No full training or new retrieval rankings in this design turn
Score-independent encoder can still infer work from its performance input
Same-passage supervision does not identify offsets between passages or guarantee cross-work distances
Canonical grouping here deliberately excludes cross-grid correspondences and does not create expert phrase/tension truth
Corpus common-pattern normalization inherited from prior work is not a proven pure performer residual
H remains a provisional score-peak window, not a validated perceptual tension episode
checkpoint: Minimum complete group-balanced validation objective for each condition; no retrieval score checkpoint selection

evaluation_plan.cross_work: exact frozen 7 opposite-view arrays/gallery/query cohort; P/H/P+H and B+P+H
evaluation_plan.within_work: leave-self-out nearest3 same piece/grid candidates from heldout work role; repercentile opposite-view original judge distances against just those candidates; expected random = 50
evaluation_plan.same_passage: heldout work target distance fit on observed unmasked search-view inputs; macro by family/work-grid/P-vs-H/Hmetric/group
evaluation_plan.controls: matching untrained encoders; old frozen summaries/previous learned model; 20 three-candidate seeds; 5 performance-order permutation seeds with actual calibrations frozen
evaluation_plan.aggregation: mean both directions per training seed, then seed mean and SD; no best seed picked
